decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C564-14. Radio and CMMS agree, so the rule allows a move. The stope holds 138 t at 12.1 g/t, which is about 53.7 oz. Likely repair is 13:20 and the range is 12:20 to 14:20. LH-09 is the closest loader, 0.34 h away, and comes from the cheap development heading DS-C564-02 at 1.5 oz/h. At 29.1 t/h an LH410 clears the stope in about 4.7 h, which is about 5 h away from development, or roughly 7.7 oz lost. Central's stockpile is at 171 t of 450 t, so there is room even though inflow will pass truck capacity. LH-08 is 0.71 h away, so I did not use it. Net gain is about 40 to 46 oz. No reserves are activated because no stope was stopped.

Keep LH-09 on C564-14 (121 t at 12.1 g/t, about 47 oz, against a dev cost of 1.5 oz/h). LH-02 is down at C512-06 until about 16:00 and the stope has 251 t at 9.2 g/t (about 74 oz). Send LH-08 from the cheap heading DS-N522-01 (1.0 oz/h, 0.75 h travel). It loads about 172 t, or about 51 oz, for a dev cost of about 6 oz. Net is about 45 oz. LH-10 is in PM until 12:00, so I'm not counting it. It could be loaned to C512-06 later. Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.
